literal_meaning: ঘুমকে ঘুমিয়ে দেওয়া (putting sleep to sleep)
figurative_meaning_en: not being able to sleep or insomnia
example_sentences_in_bangla: সারারাত ঘুমেরে ঘুম পাড়াতে আমি জেগে থাকি।
চিন্তায় ভরা মনে ঘুমেরে ঘুম পাড়ানো হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I stay awake all night trying to put sleep to sleep.
My mind filled with worries led to putting sleep to sleep.
note: This idiom vividly captures the frustration of insomnia in everyday Bengali speech.
